 Papillion couple receives IRS refund after 8-month wait 
 Tom Kircher received an automatic deposit from the IRS one week after a First Alert 6 investigation into a long delay for his tax refund. By Mike McKnight Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 10:17 PM CST | Updated : 12 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OMAHA, Neb. (WOWT) - Tom Kircher received an automatic deposit from the IRS one week after a First Alert 6 investigation into a long delay for his tax refund.
 Kircher and his wife had been waiting eight months for a refund of more than $11,000. They contacted First Alert 6 after receiving repeated notices that their tax return and refund were under review.
 First Alert 6 sent numerous emails to the IRS and also helped the couple get in contact with Rep. Mike Flood’s office.
 “We got the refund plus the interest that they had to pay because it took so long to get it, so that was great, and we’re very thankful,” Kircher said.
